meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: 把 iMessage 适配器装入 NanoClaw:复制代码、注册依赖、构建并测试,按所选模式(本机或 Photon)写配置并重启。之后 NanoClaw 可通过 iMessage 收发消息,并用你的电话号码或邮箱定位对话。
howto.when: 当你说“add imessage”“connect imessage”等触发词时,开始接入 iMessage 的流程。

say.text: 帮我把 iMessage 接入 NanoClaw
say.note: 会先问你要用本机还是 Photon 模式
需要给 Node 授予完全磁盘访问权限

say.text: 通过 Photon 接入 iMessage
say.note: 需要提供 Photon 服务器地址和 API key

howto.what_en: Installs the iMessage adapter into NanoClaw (copy, register, add dependency, build, test), then writes the mode's env config and restarts. NanoClaw can then send and receive iMessage via your phone number or Apple ID email.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say phrases like "add imessage" or "connect imessage", starting the iMessage setup flow.

say_en.note: It will ask you to choose local or Photon mode.

say_en.text: Use local mode to add iMessage
say_en.note: Requires Full Disk Access for Node.
Needs your Photon server URL and API key.
